lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: A rectilinear matrix of high-luminance circular pixel clusters distributed in a grid-like configuration along the mid-lateral flank, posterior to the branchial region.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Vertical striations of elevated luminance intersect horizontal spot clusters, forming a structural lattice of grid-like anchor nodes across the flank.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Three longitudinal linear features exhibit a high-contrast vertical gradient, tracking horizontally along the upper third of the visible flank.

other_distinctive_markers: A cluster of approximately five smaller fish, identified as remoras, is visible swimming in formation beneath the shark's ventral-lateral midline.
